description: BULK conditional primary edit — for every precinct in a HOUSE district that matches a 2024 cohort filter, set the candidate shares, in ONE call (instead of one set_primary_precinct_shares per precinct). Scopes to THIS…

clear.description: true = RESET: un-model every matching precinct back to its 2024 baseline (no shares needed). e.g. {where:{votes_total_gte:0}, clear:true} resets the whole district. Live.

district_id.description: The house district external_id, e.g. "0617" (state 06 + district 17). Or pass `url`.

dry_run.description: true = preview only (matched_count + sample, no write). Recommended first.

party.description: Which primary field. A top-two (nonpartisan) race: pass "D" (it buckets under d).

shares.description: The {candidate_id: pct} outcome to set on every matching precinct, e.g. {"<candidate_id>": 80}. Ids from describe_open_campaign / the field roster. Omit when clear:true.

url.description: Alternatively the open page URL — the district + level are parsed from ?race=house:0617&level=house.

where.description: Cohort filter on each precinct's 2024 TWO-PARTY share. e.g. {rep_share_gt: 40} (R got >40% of the two-party vote).

dem_share_gt.description: D two-party share strictly greater than this (0-100).

rep_share_gt.description: R two-party share strictly greater than this (0-100).

votes_total_gte.description: Only precincts with at least this many 2024 votes.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: apply_primary_cohort
